title: pluchea spicata
intro: Pluchea spicata, commonly known as Sea Lavender or Spiked Pluchea, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is known for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe wounds, reduce fever, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Pluchea spicata include its ability to act as an anti-histamine, reducing allergic reactions, and its potential to lower blood pressure and improve respiratory health. The bioactive constituents of Pluchea spicata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
